references.title: en.wiktionary: heute
references.supports: From MHG hiute, OHG hiutu, a contraction of hiu tagu; no German surface split

notes.rationale: aber heut ist schon der 24., but today is already the 24th: heut is DWDS's colloquial Nebenform of heute, its Lemma, and the gold description of heute is 👇📅 (Emoji Description conventions). DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root heute alone.
